integrity.proof_basis: Exact harmonic disk identity, node-centered weighted tiling/overlap inequality, Bergman square inclusion and holomorphic factorization.

scientific_limitations: Only real-valued L2 signals are covered; no complex-signal uniqueness, single-wavelet sufficiency, stability or reconstruction algorithm is claimed.
The bound beta + log(alpha) <= exp(-4p)/200 is sufficient and nonoptimal; it is much stricter than known three-window sampling bounds.
